title: Garry's Mod
notes: Played for 58 min through Highball. The game boots normally, crashed when creating a world for the first time, but I think it was a one-off problem; when I restarted the game, it went fine. I just noticed what looks like a frame time issue: the game itself runs great on the native resolution of the display, but the motion perception feels a little jittery and not 120hz, apart from that, the game runs fine and it is completely playable.
